# Billy Andrews

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  <sub>[v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>

## Appearance

Billy is a big, fat youth with a round, expressionless face. He is often seen perpetually smiling and beaming.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c8 P6](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0006), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)_

## Personality

Billy is a stolid, good-natured young man who suffers from a painful lack of conversational gifts and is considered stupid by some. He is exceptionally shy, especially when it comes to courting, though he has good sense and does not linger in heartbreak. He is dependable and a great worker with no bad habits.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c8 P6](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0006), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v3 c8 P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022)_

## History

At age twenty, Billy drove Anne Shirley, Jane Andrews, and Diana Barry to a concert at White Sands. Immensely admiring Anne, he proudly insisted she ride on the front seat with him, though his severe shyness caused him to slip away after the event to avoid attending the formal supper. After his father gave him the upper farm, Billy wished to marry Anne but was too shy to court her directly, compelling his sister Jane to ask for her hand on his behalf. Upon Anne's refusal, he did not break his heart and instead married Nettie Blewett. He proudly appeared in church with his new bride following Anne's return from college.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v3 c8 P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)_
